S.FORM: alang Tjatjigel ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Tayimari go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 354 buwan, 780 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 79% kyan ku 616 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 21% kyan ku 164 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 11%, Paywan 66%, Puyuma 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Tjatjigel hya' ga Calavi. tay 'zil na Tjatjigel hya' ga Kiring. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. hasisyo maki 1 hasisyo. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tjatjiɣel ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu tajimari ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** pajwan ** pujuma * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na tjatjiɣel ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]ala*i taj ʔzil na tjatjiɣel ħjaʔ ɣa kiriŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj ħa[s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]jo maki * ħa[s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]jo [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
